key_insight: Read-only SQL access to structured perovskite device data raised quantitative question-answering accuracy to about 51%, versus 16–23% for passage retrieval.
engineering_relevance: Reliable literature-scale comparisons of perovskite solar cells require structured experimental records, not text retrieval alone.
method: Compute 755 ground-truth answers from 45,441 measured device records.
Benchmark six retrieval architectures across 158,274 passages from 25,662 papers.
Equip an open 14B model with read-only SQL access on a single 24 GB GPU.
evidence_signal: SQL-enabled accuracy reached 51.5% on historical and 50.8% on prospective literature, while aggregate queries were largely unsolved by text retrieval alone.
watch_item: Accuracy remains near 51%, and deployment depends on reliable extraction and normalization of experimental tables.
paper_title: Benchmark for Structured Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Perovskite Photovoltaics
